title: Don’t Push Me
speaker: Pastor Erica Roth
description: Pastor Erica Roth delivered an insightful sermon titled "Don't Push Me," which focused on the story from John 2:1-11, where Jesus performs his first miracle at the wedding in Cana. Pastor Erica used this scripture to delve into the complexities of knowing when to take action and when to step back—an important lesson for us all.
